warning.titlePre: Mercedes V250/V250d Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your V250/V250d is an earlier W447 model with the OM651 diesel — that's the pre-2025 refresh generation — injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are a well-documented pattern on this engine, shared across the wider Mercedes range. We replace injector seals, timing chain components, and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

The current W447 generation (2025 refresh onward) uses a different engine, the OM654 — which doesn't share this specific issue. It's a newer design with its own characteristics, though we continue to monitor it closely.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern (per G-BRF). OM654 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to early W447/OM651 only
